option_relations.rationale: Multiple hereditary infundibulocystic basal cell carcinoma syndrome (MHIBCC) is a recognized name for SUFU-associated multiple basal cell carcinoma, especially given the genetic findings in the vignette.
Infundibulocystic basal cell carcinoma describes a histological subtype of basal cell carcinoma, which is a component of the SUFU-associated syndrome, but the option itself is not the full syndrome.

Basal cell nevus syndrome (Gorlin syndrome) is typically associated with PTCH1 mutations, not SUFU mutations, and presents with different clinical features like jaw cysts and palmar/plantar pits, which were explicitly ruled out in the vignette.
